topic: Updating frequency model for specific companies
summary_markdown: The discussion focused on updating the frequency model for a list of specified company numbers (7863, 7864, 7906, 7865, 7905, 7872). The team decided to implement the Brazilian model (`getFrequency_BR`) and applied it directly to the production environment. Testing with the ML API was noted as unstable, so the demo environment is unsuitable for this task.
decisions: Implement the Brazilian frequency model for specified companies
Deploy the updated frequency model function to the production environment
